_comment: An SCA submission whose ARCHIVE is readable throughout and whose shipped helper.js is machine-obfuscated: the build, not the developer's editor, is where the hiding happens. Obfuscation is a property of the bytes, so a bundle of somebody else's readable code says nothing here and an obfuscated file is a violation whoever produced it. That is why obfuscated-code is asked of every artifact (input: all). Route this check back to the review target and the submission passes clean, which is what the fixture is here to prevent.
